subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Bioplastics and Alternatives
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Bioplastics and Alternatives.

hook.text: A shipping container padded with mushroom-based foam instead of styrofoam. It biodegrades in your garden.

buildup.text: Bioplastics and bio-based materials replace petroleum-based packaging with plant-derived alternatives.

discovery.text: Materials like PLA, mushroom packaging, and seaweed films offer compostable or biodegradable options.

twist.text: Not all bioplastics are compostable. Some need industrial facilities that most cities lack.

climax.text: IKEA is replacing all styrofoam packaging with mushroom-based alternatives across its supply chain.

punchline.text: Nature grew the answer to packaging waste. We just need to use it.

quiz.question: What is a challenge with bioplastics?
options: Many need industrial composting facilities most cities lack
